title: Homes, Personality & Hobbies
subtitle: Describe homes, preferences, personality, and games.

sections.label: Lesson Notes
sections.title: What we explored
sections.intro: We used home and design language, personality vocabulary, hobbies, games, and a personal writing task.

cards.title: A home can reflect personality
cards.text: Colours, lighting, and decoration can show what a person likes.

cards.title: Describe a preference
cards.text: Use would like to explain an ideal home or future wish.

cards.title: Be specific
cards.text: Give examples when describing a hobby, habit, or game preference.

readings.title: A country-style home
readings.text: Zeynep would like a farmhouse in the countryside. She prefers simple decoration, wooden furniture, and good lighting. Her home reflects her personality.

opt: A game copying a real activity
